evidence.limits: No whisper.srt when coded: words come from burned-in captions (hook 0-5 s complete at 4 fps, later frames sampled every 1.5 s because the Reel is over 90 s, so many words are missed). The conference name, date and ticket price are not visible in the frames I read. The pair Reel DF5lwxHISPK was not opened. Sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Promotion of an in-person marketing conference ('כנס השיווק'): if you do not want to close your business within a year, listen to this; learn to market on social media; 400 seats; buy a ticket now.
audience: business owners and aspiring business owners
caption_vs_video_note: Caption matches: '351 tickets sold within 24 hours, only 49 last tickets', and asks for the word 'אני' to receive an order link. In the video the ticket count is not visible in the frames I read; the video shows '400 מקומות' and 'רכשו כרטיס עכשיו!'.

opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes (a self-contained warning to business owners)

visual.subject_placement: Matan standing or walking in the aisle of an empty auditorium, centred; later seated in a red seat (22-45 s).
visual.setting: An empty auditorium with rows of red seats and a dark wooden wall, intercut with crowded event footage.
visual.lighting: Dim warm theatre light, strong red tones.
visual.color_contrast: Black blazer against saturated red seats; white, green and red captions.
visual.props_and_gestures: Open arms, a bow at 21 s, pointing to the floor for 'buy a ticket' (arrow graphic), hands joined.
visual.supporting_footage: Flat icons (shop, social media logos, banknotes, five stars, down arrow, red falling graph); screenshots of his Instagram profile (about 27-29 s, 37 s, 55 s) and an analytics screen of views and followers (33-35 s); a photo pair '2019' and '2025' (36-37 s); a stage lecture (42-44 s) and a crowded audience (48-49 s, 1:16-1:20); a man in a maroon shirt (1:03).
visual.visual_progression: Standing in aisle (0-21 s) with icon overlays, then seated (22-45 s) with profile and analytics screenshots, a standing stage clip at 42 s and an audience clip at 48 s, aisle again 51 s to 1:20 with 'buy a ticket' arrows, audience at 1:16-1:20, ending in the aisle to 1:38.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: the cover is a stage photo from behind Matan with a full audience and the caption 'אני מזמין אתכם' (not spoken in frames I read)

editing.edit_function: Icons and arrows reinforce each phrase, screenshots serve as proof of reach and follower growth, crowd clips show the previous event, and the red 'buy' arrows direct the ticket purchase.
pacing_changes: t=0-32 s: icon on every phrase, aisle shots
t=33-50 s: proof inserts (analytics, 2019-2025 photos, stage, crowd)
t=51-98 s: slower, more direct sell with arrows and a final repeat of the call
editing.ending: Frames to 1:38: 'לשיווק את ההחלטה הנכונה' then red 'רכשו כרטיס עכשיו!' with a down arrow; the track ends at about 98 s.
editing.rewatch_reasons: interpretation: a sales video with fixed instruction to purchase; low rewatch value.

sound.delivery: Energetic sales cadence, speech continuous at -13 to -22 dB, a short drop at about 22 s (-42 dB) where he sits down; loud pitch at 1:21-1:25 (-11 to -14 dB).
sound.sync: Captions in phrases, icons timed to the noun, light-leak transitions at 0 s and 1:21 marking sections.

text.colour_coding: White main, green for benefits ('לסרטון הזה', 'להרוויח יותר כסף', 'לשיווק'), red for warnings and the ticket call ('לסגור את העסק שלכם', 'רכשו כרטיס עכשיו!').
text.style: Bold white sans-serif with dark outline, no box.
text.density_and_read_time: Two to five words, about 1.5 s each.
text.language: Direct imperatives and rhetorical questions; 'אתם חייבים לעמוד על במה'.
text.caption_structure: A claim of '351 tickets sold in 24 hours' and '49 last tickets', then a keyword ask 'אני' for an order link and thanks.
text.rtl_notes: Dashes at line ends ('בשנה הקרובה -') sit on the wrong side; numbers such as '400' read correctly.

story.setup: Business owners risk closing within a year.
story.stakes: Competitors do better in quality or product if you do not market.
story.progression: Listen; competitors are not better in service or product, they just earn more because of marketing; he is from the same market; he decided to tell how he went from 2019 to being a content and influence leader in Israel; 400 seats; you must stand on stage to earn more; buy a ticket.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the Reel never says the conference name, date or place in the frames I read
friction_points: t=48 s onward: long sales argument at 98 s (interpretation: long for a Reel)
t=0-4 s: the frame sequence leaves the offer unnamed until much later (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Almost every sampled comment is the single word 'אני'; one asks 'אתה עושה עוד אחד כזה ?'. The sample (24) is not representative. It shows the keyword prompt in the caption is followed by comment entries.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Replies promise a link: 'שלחתי לך נתראה בכנס', 'הלינק אצלך קנה עכשיו', 'זה אצלך שריין מקום עכשיו'.

pair_match.notes: Pair DF5lwxHISPK not opened; dossier note says Feb 2025, about 90 s, ticket sales for the same conference. This Reel is 97.9 s and sells conference tickets, so topic and duration look similar; the pair's format was not verified.

rights_and_privacy: Own footage and screenshots of his own profile and analytics; crowd shots at his event with identifiable faces; no third-party film.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: an opening warning to business owners, then proof screenshots and event crowds, a clear ticket purchase call, and a keyword comment funnel that produced comment entries.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: long (98 s) sales video with the event details missing in the frames; low reach (about 23K views) and few likes per view.
